title: Fill the reading nights
brief: Our reading nights fill unevenly because the events page is a static poster nobody can RSVP to.

target_population.role: events coordinator at a fictional independent bookstore
target_population.coverage_limit: one shop's event calendar over three weeks; RSVPs are local records with no tickets or email

core_task.summary: RSVP to a reading night and watch its remaining seats update
core_task.success_oracle: submitting an RSVP for the Thursday poetry night decrements its remaining seats from 6 to 5 and lists the attendee's initials on the card

not_applicable_states.loading: events and RSVPs are seeded local records, so seat counts change in the same frame as the submission with nothing asynchronous to show

state_recipes.empty: filter the calendar to the History genre, which has no scheduled events; a suggest-a-night prompt replaces the list
state_recipes.validation-error: submit the RSVP form with a blank name; an inline error keeps the seat count unchanged
state_recipes.success: RSVP to the poetry night as Nia F.; the card reads 5 seats left with NF listed
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the first event card's RSVP button shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the page at 390x844; event cards stack with seat meters full width

acceptance_facts: The seed lists five upcoming events across three weeks with seat capacities between 12 and 30.
An RSVP to the poetry night reduces its remaining seats from 6 to 5 without any payment or ticket step.
Filtering to a genre with no scheduled events shows a suggest-a-night prompt instead of a blank list.

product_signature.mechanism: seat-meter cards that show how full each reading night is before you commit
product_signature.anchor: event card rail on the storefront page
product_signature.brief_trace: a static poster nobody can RSVP to
product_signature.counterfactual: a plain poster grid would fit a flyer-archive brief and cannot hold seats or take an RSVP
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the poetry card at 5 seats with the new initials listed

anti_goals: no ticket sales, payments, or fees of any kind
no email confirmations or notifications; RSVPs live on the page
no scraped author bios or cover images; all event copy is invented

content_seed.data_notes: five invented events at the fictional Pelt & Quill bookshop; History is intentionally absent from the schedule to fix the empty state
